message.content: **Columbia University** is an Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the U.S., known for its rigorous academics, distinguished faculty, and notable alumni—including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and U.S. presidents. Columbia offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across a wide range of disciplines, including humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, business, law, medicine, and journalism. Its main campus is situated on Morningside Heights in Manhattan, while additional campuses include the Columbia Business School in Midtown Manhattan and the Columbia Law School in the Upper West Side.
